note: doc/phase3_5_tasks_and_acceptance.md section 7. Twenty-seven standards across nine work packages. Every one starts NOT VERIFIED; a standard is met only when its own checker reports it, and no standard is met by percentage.

packages.title: upstream adapters and an installable build
product API, cache, report and dump

A.until_then: no automatic layout optimisation is wired in

B.must_hold: the optimisation is real AND safe
B.until_then: the formal gain gate is not run; semantics and ownership are fixed first

C.must_hold: the gain is observable on the accepted R3 hardware
C.until_then: NOT VERIFIED if unrun; PERFORMANCE_NOT_MET if run and short

D.until_then: nothing is claimed to be deliverable

mutations.what: ignore the bank in the cost model
leave the opt level out of the cache key
pass a model cycle off as a measured one
forge a PASS or hide a slow case

modes.B0: the frozen existing product behaviour, its existing optimisations included
modes.O0: the new driver's compatibility path; machine code identical to B0 on the frozen cases
modes.O1: upstream canonicalisation/CSE and proven AxisInfo lowering; legacy layout and allocation
modes.O2: O1 plus LL-driven layout selection, bank-aware allocation and conservative local scheduling
modes.O2-no-LL: the ablation: O1 plus whatever scheduling stands alone, with LL-driven decisions off and a legacy legal plan used instead. No computation is deleted.
